records.description: Free Lean Canvas tool for startups. Build your Lean Canvas with sticky notes, save locally in your browser. FreeCanvas is a fast, local-only Lean Canvas web application designed to streamline your business planning process. This innovative tool allows users to create and manage Lean Canvases directly in their browser without the need for accounts, databases, or backend services. Everything lives in the browser, ensuring your data remains private and secure.

records.name: HoneyRuns
records.tagline: We help mobile auto mechanics generate revenue faster
records.description: Mobile mechanics only fix what's requested, missing other needed maintenance - causing repeat visits or overselling that damages trust. HoneyRuns integrates fleet telematics and FMS with mobile mechanic operations systems, showing mechanics exactly what each vehicle needs before arrival. Mechanics maximize revenue per visit with data-backed work, fleets get comprehensive service in one trip, and vehicle data eliminates pricing disputes.

Not just error counts. itbroke.dev tracks JavaScript errors, 404s, network failures, and rage clicks on your website. Then ranks them by how much revenue they're losing you. See what pages convert, where users drop off, and which errors are blocking the path. One script tag. Real-time data. No SDK. No configuration. Early access special: Free forever for one site. Every feature. No credit card.

records.description: Injexzero AI is a plug-and-play API that protects your LLM applications from prompt injection attacks and PII leakage. Drop in one API call — two AI models analyze every prompt using ensemble voting and return a risk score in under 100ms. It also detects and masks 40+ PII types (names, emails, credit cards, SSN, and more) using a LangGraph-powered AI agent. Built for developers. Free tier included. No credit card needed.

records.tagline: Minimalist 2026-2032 Calendar. Dark Mode. No Ads.
records.description: I built HolidaysCalendar.net because I was tired of cluttered calendar sites filled with popups and video ads. This is a privacy-first, lightning-fast calendar for 2026-2032. ✅ Automatic Dark Mode ✅ Zero Tracking & No Ads ✅ Print-friendly CSS ✅ Verified global holiday data for 100+ countries.

records.description: Agent Bar lives in your menu bar and gives you a native GUI for Claude Code. Pick a project, talk to it with your voice, watch tool calls stream in real-time, approve or auto-approve actions, and track token costs — all without leaving your desktop.

records.description: Block suggestive and NSFW images while browsing. Protect your focus, your wallet, and your sanity.

records.name: TunnelBuddy
records.tagline: Borrow a friend’s internet. Or lend them yours.
records.description: Sometimes you’re away and you want to surf the Internet just as if you were at Home, either because some online services are tied to a given Household, or because you’re abroad and can’t access content available back home. TunnelBuddy is very easy to use: start it on 2 computers, share a one-time password, and that’s it. No account creation, no credit card. The app is free and secure (traffic is encrypted end-to-end). I built this for myself and just want to share it with the world!

records.name: FocusLab
records.tagline: Reclaim your focus. The all-in-one productivity suite.
records.description: Stop letting distractions steal your life. FocusLab combines ruthless website blocking with unique wellness tools to prevent burnout. 🚫 Block: Ban time-wasting websites 📊 Gamify: Watch your "Life Time Saved" grow daily. 🍅 Flow: Integrated Pomodoro, To-Do, Calendar & Ambient Music. 🫁 De-stress: Built-in Cardiac Coherence breathing exercises. 👁️ Health: Smart 20-20-20 Eye Guard reminders. Don't just work harder, work healthier. Reclaim your focus today.

records.name: Fixure | Security Decision Intelligence
records.tagline: Turn security chaos into system clarity
records.description: Security teams don’t lack data. They lack clarity. Fixure is a Security Decision Intelligence layer that sits above existing security tools. It reconciles duplicated and conflicting signals into a single model of reality, explains downstream impact, and helps teams understand what matters before taking action. Fixure doesn’t generate findings. It makes sense of what you already have.

records.name: CosmicGuide AI
records.tagline: AI astrology built on NASA-grade planetary data
records.description: Move beyond generic horoscopes. CosmicGuide uses NASA/JPL-grade ephemeris data to calculate real planetary positions against YOUR exact birth chart, then AI interprets what those transits actually mean for you. Get a free Cosmic Blueprint with your full natal chart, or try Daily Cosmic Weather -- personalized timing intelligence delivered every morning with 4 time blocks so you know when to push and when to pause. Plus deep-dive reports for love, compatibility, money, and your year ahead.

records.name: Knytstudio
records.tagline: Design, share, and remix cross-stitch patterns
records.description: Cross-stitch tools haven't changed in decades — expensive Windows apps and locked PDFs you can't edit. Knytstudio is a free, browser-based pattern editor. Design from scratch, convert photos into stitchable charts with DMC colors, or describe your idea and get a pattern instantly. What's unique: every published pattern can be remixed. Want different colors or a different size? Remix it. It's like open source for craft patterns. No download, no signup required to start.

It strips everything back to what actually matters. You can: Track deals without noise See exactly what needs attention Get AI-powered deal summaries and suggested next steps No cloud sync. records.description: Stop losing money on forgotten SaaS subscriptions and "ghost" licenses. While other tools just list your apps, Toolspend deep-dives into your actual usage and spend patterns. We identify underutilized seats, detect duplicate tools across teams, and alert you before every renewal. Toolspend helps you automate the toil of procurement so you can focus on building!

records.description: CoThou is an autonomous superagent that reasons from first principles to turn users’ thoughts and complex tasks into actionable deliverables. Each task runs in an isolated sandbox for maximum security and can work fully autonomously for up to 24 hours—without any human intervention—until completion.

records.name: TimeTracker

Install or run in browser. 📊 Professional Reports. Clean PDF reports with rates and billable hours. 🔒 Privacy First. No cookies, no tracking. 💾 Full JSON export.

Works for cleaning, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and 50+ more industries. No contracts, cancel anytime.

records.description: FlickerSense turns your iPhone into a light quality analyzer. Using 240 FPS camera capture and FFT analysis, it detects invisible light flicker (50–120 Hz) from LEDs and fluorescents linked to headaches, eye strain, and focus issues. Also measures color temperature (Kelvin) and brightness (lux). Built for people with light sensitivity, ADHD, epilepsy, and anyone optimizing their environment. Free unlimited scans. Premium adds trends, blue light analysis, workplace compliance, and export.

Unlike one-time generation workflows, you can keep iterating, fixing issues, and shipping updates through chat. Build frontend, backend, or full-stack with database.

Just tell it what you need — it plans, executes, and keeps things moving in the background. Autonomous, secure, and built to run 24/7 so you can focus on what matters.

records.name: HookWatch
records.tagline: Automated webhook monitoring for indie hackers & small teams
records.description: Never miss a webhook again. HookWatch monitors, logs, and retries your webhooks automatically. Built for indie hackers and small teams. Simple setup, affordable pricing, peace of mind.

Creators can start with curated generative templates, export for web use, or publish their own recipes, and discover and remix community creations.

records.name: Smoosh: Subscription Tracker

The result is real time voice clone detection after instant device verification to protect against spoofing.

Browse a curated recipe collection, save your favorites, and use the built-in calculator for perfect dough every time. Available in English and German today, Free to start. Premium unlocks all recipes, removes ads, and discounts certificates.

records.description: I launched my iOS app ClearDay, and it’s designed for people who are tired of bloated productivity tools. I built it because I found most productivity apps I tried felt too complicated or slow so I built ClearDay to have everything you need in a simple, minimalistic way - no logins, no ads, no distractions. ClearDay has three main features: A To-Do list, a Calendar and a Focus Timer. It is completely offline: no ads, trackers or login.

records.description: Privacy-focused encrypted message & images app. Secure text encryption with local processing—no data storage, 100% private.

records.name: Jinee AI

Jinee AI joins your call and speaks. Ask it a question, it pulls real data from your systems and answers out loud. Not after the meeting. Not in a follow-up. Right there. Not a note-taker. A participant.
